authority: Owner standing direction 1 (15 Oct 2026): Meshy, no generation cap; reference-backed agent-drafted art.
method: Meshy has no texture-generation endpoint (checked https://docs.meshy.ai/en/api and openapi.json: Retexture only re-textures an existing model). Generated as a seamless square image with POST /openapi/v1/image-to-image (nano-banana-pro, generate_multi_view false, aspect_ratio 1:1) from the three reference boards, then a 32-px gradient-domain wrap-seam correction (local script, no external pixels).

chosen_concept.prompt: Seamless tileable square texture, top-down orthographic view, flat even lighting, no perspective, no shadows from a single light: wet dark slate-grey and blue-grey tide rock surface with clusters of cream barnacles, small mussels and strands of dark olive-green and teal kelp in the cracks, stylised hand-painted game texture in the Palworld/Quaternius style matching the attached boards' wet rock swatch, edges wrap seamlessly on all four sides, represents a 2 metre square patch. No red, no text. The texture fills the ENTIRE canvas edge to edge: absolutely NO border, NO frame, NO margin, NO vignette; rock shapes and kelp continue off every edge and wrap around.

rejected_concepts.reason: dark frame border around the tile breaks seamless tiling

integration_status: candidate, flag-off; albedo/mask only (no normal/roughness generated)
credits_note: Sum of consumed_credits reported by the Meshy task API for every task listed in tasks_with_credits.
visual_verdict: Good: wet blue-grey tide rock with barnacles, mussels and kelp, wraps cleanly after seam correction; albedo only.
